description: NaMgV₂Bi₃O₁₀ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.82 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted MgO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent BiO₆ octahedra, corners with three VO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one BiO₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-84°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.05 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent BiO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one BiO₅ square pyramid, and corners with two equivalent MgO₄ trigonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-68°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.90 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent BiO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent BiO₅ square pyramids, and  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-65°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.71-1.96 Å. There are three inequivalent Bi sites. In the first Bi site, Bi is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted BiO₅ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one BiO₆ octahedra, corners with three VO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one BiO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 37°. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.54 Å. In the second Bi site, Bi is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted BiO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one BiO₅ square pyramid, corners with four VO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₄ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one BiO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.71 Å. In the third Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.64 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one V and two Bi atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one V, and one Bi atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted L-shaped geometry to one Na and one V atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Bi atoms to form distorted edge-sharing ONaBi₃ tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mg, one V, and one Bi atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Mg, one V, and two Bi atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one V and two Bi atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one V, and one Bi atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Mg, one V, and one Bi atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONaMgVBi tetrahedra. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and three Bi atoms.
